verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents admin-configurable retention policies, scheduled auto-deletion of transcripts or recordings, or on-demand permanent erasure. Enterprise audit trails, activity logs, SSO, and the training opt-out are adjacent controls and earn no credit. A community user deleting their own account is not an admin retention or erase capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand
